nodes.name: Retrieve

nodes.name: Save

nodes.name: verify_user
nodes.summary: Helper function that verifies a user's password against the bcrypt-hashed value stored in MongoDB.

nodes.name: get_user_messages
nodes.summary: Helper function that retrieves the list of messages stored for a given username from the MongoDB users collection.

tour.title: Project Overview and Documentation
tour.description: Start here to understand what the project is about and how to run it. The README provides build/run instructions using Docker Compose and explains how to test the API endpoints with Postman.

tour.title: Container Orchestration with Docker Compose
tour.description: Understand how the two services — the Flask web app and MongoDB database — are wired together. Docker Compose defines port mappings, service linking, and build contexts for both containers.

tour.title: Python Dependencies and App Entry Point
tour.description: Explore the dependency manifest to see which libraries power the API: Flask, flask_restful, pymongo, and bcrypt. The web Dockerfile installs these and launches app.py as the container entrypoint.

tour.title: First API Endpoint: Hello World
tour.description: Start with the simplest endpoint to understand how flask_restful Resource classes are structured. The Hello class shows the minimal pattern: a GET method that returns a static response.

tour.title: User Registration and Authentication Endpoints
tour.description: Examine the Register, Retrieve, and Save resources to understand the full user lifecycle: creating an account with a hashed password, authenticating to fetch stored messages, and saving new messages. These three endpoints demonstrate the core application logic.

tour.title: Data Layer: MongoDB Helper Functions
tour.description: Dive into the three helper functions that encapsulate all direct MongoDB interactions. These functions handle username existence checks, bcrypt password verification, and message retrieval — keeping database logic separate from the resource classes.

project.name: python_rest_tutorial
project.description: A simple Flask REST API with MongoDB backend, containerized using Docker and docker-compose. Provides user registration, authentication, and message storage endpoints.
